# Security

Use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/XCP/collections/security/advisories/new)
for a vulnerability in repository tooling, adapters, or CI.

Use the public
[collection change form](https://github.com/XCP/collections/issues/new?template=collection-change.yml)
for incorrect collection membership, metadata, traits, or links.

Do not include wallet secrets, seed phrases, API credentials, or other private
keys in either report.
